No rejection grounds: the entity is active in customs data as recently as 2026-02-07, so it is neither non-existent nor liquidated. Note the PAN AALCM2906K and the 'Delhi' state claim were not independently verified in this pass (registry access blocked); the customs address '697 Udyog Vihar Phase V' is consistent with Delhi NCR but is not a PAN confirmation.
